items.title: Pixel 10 with Gemini Intelligence, custom widgets, and more in our November Pixel Drop
items.excerpt: Explore the latest Pixel features, including Gemini Intelligence on Pixel 10, HiLight alerts for Google Messages, and more.
items.rationale: Primary-source release: the November Pixel Drop brings Gemini Intelligence (Rambler dictation, Create My Widget, proactive Gemini actions) to Pixel 10 owners today, so it changes what the phone does tomorrow.

items.title: Ring’s Indoor Drone Camera Is Back—and Now Powered by AI
items.excerpt: This $250 Drone Cam flies around your home to monitor threats. There’s also the Rover Cam for businesses, featuring the guts of Amazon’s former Astro robot.
items.rationale: New hardware launch: Ring's $250 AI-piloted indoor Drone Cam (January) plus an Astro-derived Rover Cam, a priced, dated consumer robot product.

items.title: This New Linux-Based Desktop Operating System Is Built for AI Nerds
items.excerpt: Built by Cyanogen’s cofounder, Kora is a next-gen alternative to Windows and macOS built for power users running local AI models.
items.rationale: New platform: Kora, an AI-native Linux desktop OS co-engineered with Qualcomm for Snapdragon X2 Elite, built for running local models on-device.

items.title: DeepMind reveals Gemini Robotics 2.5 and open safety benchmark "ASIMOV-jailbreak"
items.excerpt: The new model is up to twice as successful at some tasks.
items.rationale: New model release driving real robots (Apptronik Apollo at Mercedes-Benz) with up to 2x task success, plus an open jailbreak-safety benchmark for embodied AI.

items.title: Apple has new Mac app coming to make running local AI models easy
items.excerpt: Leaker Aaron Perris has discovered evidence of a new Mac app in the works at Apple that makes it easy to run local AI models.
items.rationale: Evidence of a first-party Apple app for running local models on Mac, a signal that on-device AI is moving from hobbyist tooling into macOS itself.
